translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: A ach ayach och yipoc in c'ool

content.text: Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal, cham val ab'an tas svala'. Tac'van̈ d'ayin, ina to te tojol ach, tzac'ann̈ejelc'och tas tzala'.
Man̈ a c'anb'ej tas vaj a in a checab' in tic, yujto malaj junoc mach vach' yaj d'a a sat.
Ix in pechji b'eyec' yuj eb' ayoch ajc'olal d'ayin, ix in stec'anem eb' d'a sat luum. Ix in yac' cajnaj eb' d'a scal q'uic'alq'uinal, icha val yaj eb' chamnacxo.
Man̈xo animaoc vaj ticnaic svab'i, te somchajnac in c'ool.
Tzin nacot juntzan̈ c'ual ec'nac d'a peca', tzin naub'tan̈an masanil tas a b'onac d'a yalan̈tax chi'.
A d'ayach tzin mojb'ejq'ue in c'ab', tzach in nib'ej val, icha val junoc lum taquin̈ luum snib'an a a'.
Mamin Jehová, tac'van̈ d'ayin d'a elan̈chamel, toxo val tz'el in c'ol svab'i. Man̈ a yaej a colval d'ayin. Icha val eb' chamnac smucchajemi, icham chi' ol in ajoc tato tza yaej a colval d'ayin.
Ac' in nacot a vach'c'olal d'a junjun q'uin̈ib'alil, ina to a ach tzach vac'och yipoc in c'ool. Ch'ox d'ayin tas ol aj in b'eyb'ati, yujto van in lesalvi d'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, colinel d'a yol sc'ab' eb' ajc'ool, yujto a d'ayach tzin say in colnab'il.
C'ayb'ej in yic tzin b'o icha tas tza nib'ej, yujto in Diosal ach. Aocab' Espíritu vach' tzin ic'an b'ey d'a a vach' b'eyb'al.
Mamin, man̈ in a cha chamoc, yic vach' max alchaj chucal lolonel d'ayach. Ic' in elta d'a scal vilc'olal, yujto vach' ach toni.
Yuj a vach'c'olal d'ayin, yuj chi' tza satcanel masanil eb' ayoch ajc'olal d'ayin, yujto a checab' in.
